expected: Preserve the captured current Professional Development offering, including topics, formats, duration, group-size limit, and facilitator context, while labeling details for launch verification.
observed: The rendered page says the record does not establish a current program and omits the saved offering details; CONTENT-COVERAGE.tsv nevertheless marks the related rows implemented=yes and verified=yes.
measurement_or_evidence: The source lists a 90-minute tour and Q&A, half-day and full-day formats, groups up to five, named facilitator context, and seven topic areas. The rendered page contains only a historical 2018 record and generic contact path.
recommended_fix: Restore the source-grounded offering as captured-current information with visible launch-current qualifiers; retain the historical-price exclusion; add the approved inquiry boundary and See Our Approach route.

route_or_source: /news/{slug}; 16 supported article text files plus babycow--ed5ac122.txt
expected: Migrate every supported first-party HTML article, story, and report into the repeatable record type with meaningful dated content, status, provenance, and relevant original-file or approved source access.
observed: All 17 record pages contain only a short summary, author, topic, and the same generic About this record paragraph; no record preserves its source-specific body or specific provenance. The coverage generator still assigns archive-record plus implemented=yes and verified=yes.
measurement_or_evidence: The 16 article extracts excluding the archive hub plus the Baby Cow extract contain 22,691 extracted words before navigation/footer cleanup. The tested Building Community source contains a substantive multi-paragraph article, while its rendered record omits that body. Every record uses the same src/pages.jsx record template.

Suitable starting replacements include ASSET-003, ASSET-098, ASSET-141, ASSET-145, ASSET-149, ASSET-183, ASSET-184, ASSET-196, ASSET-233, ASSET-059, ASSET-061, ASSET-087, and ASSET-130; review visible third-party art or marks before launch.

expected: Every route must reflow without horizontal page overflow or clipped text at all required widths.

measurement_or_evidence: Measured rendered document widths: 951 versus 768 pixels, 664 versus 390 pixels, and 517 versus 320 pixels; overflow is 183, 274, and 197 pixels.
recommended_fix: Allow safe line breaking around the slash or insert an accessible break opportunity; add overflow-wrap for long record headings; retest all 17 titles at 768, 390, and 320 pixels.

route_or_source: global header, cards, captions, and links
expected: Keep utility text, captions, metadata, navigation, and controls comfortably readable while retaining the coherent two-family type system.
observed: The Literata and Atkinson Hyperlegible pairing is appropriate and legally bundled, but several functional roles are unusually small.
measurement_or_evidence: Measured desktop: utility navigation 11.68px, main navigation 12.8px, card metadata 11.52px, caption 12.16px, text link 14.4px, button 14.72px. Phone caption falls to 11.2px and mobile wordmark subtitle is 9.075px. Body is 17px desktop and 16.5px phone; Home H1 is 82.08px desktop and 58.5px phone.
recommended_fix: Raise utility, metadata, caption, subtitle, and action text to a restrained readable floor; preserve Literata for display and Atkinson Hyperlegible for functional/body roles; retest wrapping at 200 percent zoom.

expected: Normal-size text must meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its actual background.
observed: Deep action-blue links on light-gray and pale-blue fields miss the normal-text threshold.
measurement_or_evidence: Measured ratios are 4.41:1 on #EAEAEE and 4.29:1 on the pale-blue field at 14.4px/700. The failures recur in 20 route/viewport checks across the four routes.
recommended_fix: Use a slightly darker derived action blue for text links on tinted fields or adjust the field tint; keep #1470AF for controls where the text/background pairing already passes.

expected: Whitespace should create hierarchy without making sparse sections feel unfinished or substantially longer than their content.
observed: The second Employment section contains large blank bands above and below a short two-column row; Professional Development also uses oversized fixed section padding for limited content.
measurement_or_evidence: Employment section at 1440: 1,096px tall, 520px occupied, 288px blank above and below. At 390: 1,143px tall, 787px occupied, 178px above and below. Professional Development section at 1440: 958px tall with 144px top and bottom gaps. Evidence: employment-desktop.png and professional-development-desktop.png.
recommended_fix: Remove or reduce the wide-row minimum height and use content-driven padding tokens; reduce sparse interior-section padding while preserving deliberate pauses.

expected: Use rules where they clarify chronology or metadata, while relying mainly on typography, alignment, photography, spacing, and blue fields.
observed: The visual system repeatedly boxes cards and uses ruled rows or black-gap grids across unrelated page types, creating a broadsheet/spreadsheet texture beyond the chronological archive.
measurement_or_evidence: At 1440 the News page contains 84 bordered elements. Across the system there are about 14 recurring border patterns: four boxed card systems, three black-gap split grids, six ruled-list/timeline systems, and the repeated two-rule owner notice.
recommended_fix: Keep rules for dated resource rows and genuine comparisons; remove outlines from secondary cards and service-page grids, replace black-gap grids with spacing/alignment, and simplify owner notices.

expected: Serve appropriately sized responsive imagery and only the font subsets/formats actually needed.
observed: The build ships original JPEGs without srcset or sizes and imports full Fontsource CSS for five weights, generating many unused script/font assets.
measurement_or_evidence: The 11 JPEGs total 8.1MB; meadow-inquiry.jpg is 2.4MB at 2500 by 3333 but renders at 313 by 209 on the phone Home page. The production build emits 47 font files totaling 664KB. JS plus CSS total about 320KB uncompressed.
recommended_fix: Generate distinct responsive widths in a modern format with width/height, srcset, and sizes; import only required Latin font subsets and WOFF2 assets; confirm no visual regression.

expected: Interactive targets should be approximately 44 by 44 CSS pixels where practical.

measurement_or_evidence: Computed target measurement repeated across all 31 desktop route checks.
recommended_fix: Increase the disclosure target to at least 44px wide without changing label order or the independent /about link.
